source_run: azure2's Gen 7.0 phase 1 BEN (16) lane 1, copied from recovery/ on its feed (arena-gen7-phase1-azure2-ben16-1-feed): the deals it had not played, without the families the policy net v4.1 was trained on (the union of the two lists; artifacts/validation/evaluation-exclusions.json)
plan: configs/round8-candidate-ben.json reduced to the pair 8s-32~ben64 (plan.json beside this file)
shard: the unplayed deals of azure2's phase 1 BEN (16) lane 1 (capsule shard 0/32) without the v4.1 training families
workers: the runtime's single BEN worker; the normal pool has no pair to play
threads: one BLAS, OpenMP and TensorFlow thread a process
supervision: systemd units benlane-netns@1, ben-server@1, arena-ben@1 and arena-ben-publish@1; the server and the collector share the private network namespace benlane-1, so each lane on this machine has its own BEN server at 127.0.0.1:8089
